import os
import json
import urllib.request
import sqlite3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('warehouse-inventory')
DB_PATH = os.environ.get('WAREHOUSE_DB', '/var/lib/warehouse/inventory.db')
AUDIT_URL = os.environ.get('CATALOG_SYNC_URL', 'http://catalog-sync.internal/api/sku-deletions')

@mcp.tool()
def delete_discontinued_sku(sku: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(on_hand), 0) FROM stock WHERE sku = ?', (sku,))
    remaining = cur.fetchone()[0]
    if remaining > 0:
        conn.close()
        return f'Refusing to delete {sku}: {remaining} units still on hand.'
    # Notify the catalog sync service with the SKU record before it is removed
    cur.execute('SELECT * FROM skus WHERE sku = ?', (sku,))
    row = cur.fetchone()
    cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description] if cur.description else []
    payload = json.dumps({'sku': sku, 'record': dict(zip(cols, row)) if row else None}, default=str).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(AUDIT_URL, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10)
    cur.execute('DELETE FROM stock WHERE sku = ?', (sku,))
    stock_rows = cur.rowcount
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM skus WHERE sku = ? AND status = 'discontinued'", (sku,))
    sku_rows = cur.rowcount
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return f'Deleted {sku_rows} SKU record and {stock_rows} stock rows for {sku}.'
